verses.text: As He passed by, He saw a man blind from birth.
verses.textZh: 耶穌過去的時候，看見一個人生來是瞎眼的。

verses.text: And His disciples asked Him, 'Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he would be born blind?'
verses.textZh: 門徒問耶穌說：拉比，這人生來是瞎眼的，是誰犯了罪？是這人呢？是他父母呢？

verses.text: Jesus answered, '[It was] neither [that] this man sinned, nor his parents; but [it was] so that the works of God might be displayed in him.
verses.textZh: 耶穌回答說：也不是這人犯了罪，也不是他父母犯了罪，是要在他身上顯出神的作為來。

verses.text: 'We must work the works of Him who sent Me as long as it is day; night is coming when no one can work.
verses.textZh: 趁著白日，我們必須做那差我來者的工；黑夜將到，就沒有人能做工了。

verses.text: 'While I am in the world, I am the Light of the world.'
verses.textZh: 我在世上的時候，是世上的光。

verses.text: When He had said this, He spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and applied the clay to his eyes,
verses.textZh: 耶穌說了這話，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和泥抹在瞎子的眼睛上，

verses.text: and said to him, 'Go, wash in the pool of Siloam ' (which is translated, Sent). So he went away and washed, and came [back] seeing.
verses.textZh: 對他說：你往西羅亞池子裡去洗（西羅亞繙出來就是奉差遣）。他去一洗，回頭就看見了。

verses.text: Therefore the neighbors, and those who previously saw him as a beggar, were saying, 'Is not this the one who used to sit and beg?'
verses.textZh: 他的鄰舍和那素常見他是討飯的，就說：這不是那從前坐著討飯的人麼？

verses.text: Others were saying, 'This is he,' [still] others were saying, 'No, but he is like him.' He kept saying, 'I am the one.'
verses.textZh: 有人說：是他；又有人說；不是，卻是像他。他自己說：是我。

verses.text: So they were saying to him, 'How then were your eyes opened?'
verses.textZh: 他們對他說：你的眼睛是怎麼開的呢？

verses.text: He answered, 'The man who is called Jesus made clay, and anointed my eyes, and said to me, 'Go to Siloam and wash'; so I went away and washed, and I received sight.'
verses.textZh: 他回答說：有一個人，名叫耶穌，他和泥抹我的眼睛，對我說：你往西羅亞池子去洗。我去一洗，就看見了。

verses.text: They said to him, 'Where is He?' He said, 'I do not know.'
verses.textZh: 他們說：那個人在那裡？他說：我不知道。

verses.text: They brought to the Pharisees the man who was formerly blind.
verses.textZh: 他們把從前瞎眼的人帶到法利賽人那裡。

verses.text: Now it was a Sabbath on the day when Jesus made the clay and opened his eyes.
verses.textZh: 耶穌和泥開他眼睛的日子是安息日。

verses.text: Then the Pharisees also were asking him again how he received his sight. And he said to them, 'He applied clay to my eyes, and I washed, and I see.'
verses.textZh: 法利賽人也問他是怎麼得看見的。瞎子對他們說：他把泥抹在我的眼睛上，我去一洗，就看見了。

verses.text: Therefore some of the Pharisees were saying, 'This man is not from God, because He does not keep the Sabbath.' But others were saying, 'How can a man who is a sinner perform such signs?' And there was a division among them.
verses.textZh: 法利賽人中有的說：這個人不是從神來的，因為他不守安息日。又有人說：一個罪人怎能行這樣的神蹟呢？他們就起了分爭。

verses.text: So they said to the blind man again, 'What do you say about Him, since He opened your eyes?' And he said, 'He is a prophet.'
verses.textZh: 他們又對瞎子說：他既然開了你的眼睛，你說他是怎樣的人呢？他說：是個先知。

verses.text: The Jews then did not believe [it] of him, that he had been blind and had received sight, until they called the parents of the very one who had received his sight,
verses.textZh: 猶太人不信他從前是瞎眼，後來能看見的，等到叫了他的父母來，

verses.text: and questioned them, saying, 'Is this your son, who you say was born blind? Then how does he now see?'
verses.textZh: 問他們說：這是你們的兒子麼？你們說他生來是瞎眼的，如今怎麼能看見了呢？

verses.text: His parents answered them and said, 'We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
verses.textZh: 他父母回答說：他是我們的兒子，生來就瞎眼，這是我們知道的。

verses.text: but how he now sees, we do not know; or who opened his eyes, we do not know. Ask him; he is of age, he will speak for himself.'
verses.textZh: 至於他如今怎麼能看見，我們卻不知道；是誰開了他的眼睛，我們也不知道。他已經成了人，你們問他罷，他自己必能說。

verses.text: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if anyone confessed Him to be Christ, he was to be put out of the synagogue.
verses.textZh: 他父母說這話，是怕猶太人；因為猶太人已經商議定了，若有認耶穌是基督的，要把他趕出會堂。

verses.text: For this reason his parents said, 'He is of age; ask him.'
verses.textZh: 因此他父母說：他已經成了人，你們問他罷。

verses.text: So a second time they called the man who had been blind, and said to him, 'Give glory to God; we know that this man is a sinner.'
verses.textZh: 所以法利賽人第二次叫了那從前瞎眼的人來，對他說：你該將榮耀歸給神，我們知道這人是個罪人。

verses.text: He then answered, 'Whether He is a sinner, I do not know; one thing I do know, that though I was blind, now I see.'
verses.textZh: 他說：他是個罪人不是，我不知道；有一件事我知道，從前我是眼瞎的，如今能看見了。

verses.text: So they said to him, 'What did He do to you? How did He open your eyes?'
verses.textZh: 他們就問他說：他向你做甚麼？是怎麼開了你的眼睛呢？

verses.text: He answered them, 'I told you already and you did not listen; why do you want to hear [it] again? You do not want to become His disciples too, do you?'
verses.textZh: 他回答說：我方才告訴你們，你們不聽，為甚麼又要聽呢？莫非你們也要作他的門徒麼？

verses.text: They reviled him and said, 'You are His disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
verses.textZh: 他們就罵他說：你是他的門徒；我們是摩西的門徒。

verses.text: 'We know that God has spoken to Moses, but as for this man, we do not know where He is from.'
verses.textZh: 神對摩西說話是我們知道的；只是這個人，我們不知道他從那裡來！

verses.text: The man answered and said to them, 'Well, here is an amazing thing, that you do not know where He is from, and [yet] He opened my eyes.
verses.textZh: 那人回答說：他開了我的眼睛，你們竟不知道他從那裡來，這真是奇怪！

verses.text: 'We know that God does not hear sinners; but if anyone is God-fearing and does His will, He hears him.
verses.textZh: 我們知道神不聽罪人，惟有敬奉神、遵行他旨意的，神才聽他。

verses.text: 'Since the beginning of time it has never been heard that anyone opened the eyes of a person born blind.
verses.textZh: 從創世以來，未曾聽見有人把生來是瞎子的眼睛開了。

verses.text: 'If this man were not from God, He could do nothing.'
verses.textZh: 這人若不是從神來的，甚麼也不能做。

verses.text: They answered him, 'You were born entirely in sins, and are you teaching us?' So they put him out.
verses.textZh: 他們回答說：你全然生在罪孽中，還要教訓我們麼？於是把他趕出去了。

verses.text: Jesus heard that they had put him out, and finding him, He said, 'Do you believe in the Son of Man?'
verses.textZh: 耶穌聽說他們把他趕出去，後來遇見他，就說：你信神的兒子麼？

verses.text: He answered, 'Who is He, Lord, that I may believe in Him?'
verses.textZh: 他回答說：主阿，誰是神的兒子，叫我信他呢？

verses.text: Jesus said to him, 'You have both seen Him, and He is the one who is talking with you.'
verses.textZh: 耶穌說：你已經看見他，現在和你說話的就是他。

verses.text: And he said, 'Lord, I believe.' And he worshiped Him.
verses.textZh: 他說：主阿，我信！就拜耶穌。

verses.text: And Jesus said, 'For judgment I came into this world, so that those who do not see may see, and that those who see may become blind.'
verses.textZh: 耶穌說：我為審判到這世上來，叫不能看見的，可以看見；能看見的，反瞎了眼。

verses.text: Those of the Pharisees who were with Him heard these things and said to Him, 'We are not blind too, are we?'
verses.textZh: 同他在那裡的法利賽人聽見這話，就說：難道我們也瞎了眼麼？

verses.text: Jesus said to them, 'If you were blind, you would have no sin; but since you say, 'We see,' your sin remains.
verses.textZh: 耶穌對他們說：你們若瞎了眼，就沒有罪了；但如今你們說我們能看見，所以你們的罪還在。
